name: V495 Cyg
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 6.72 days; its mean radius is 95.1 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V495 Cyg: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 95.1 +/- 15.4 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 380, Name='V495 Cyg', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V495 Cyg: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3181.2 +/- 506.6 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.977 +/- 0.055 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 6.7 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 95.1 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,181 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, V495 Cyg: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.
